name: Atomic Flutter iOS
on:
  push:
    branches: [codex/atomic-flutter-testflight]
    paths-ignore:
      - '.github/workflows/flutter-play.yml'
      - 'flutter/android/**'
      - 'packages/atomic_store_flutter/cargokit/gradle/**'
      - 'packages/atomic_store_flutter/cargokit/build_tool/lib/src/android_environment.dart'
      - 'flutter/.gitignore'
      - '**/*.md'
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      ref:
        description: "Commit to build (default: the triggering ref)"
        required: false
        default: ''
        type: string
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      ref:
        description: "Commit or branch to build (default: the selected ref)"
        required: false
        default: ''
        type: string
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: atomic-flutter-ios-${{ inputs.ref || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  ios:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    env:
      ATOMIC_CARGO_TARGET_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/packages/atomic_store_flutter/rust/target
      HAS_APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_PRIVATE_KEY != '' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref || github.sha }}
      - name: Compute build number
        id: build
        # Minutes since the Unix epoch: always increases and beats every earlier
        # run_number, on both platforms, so stores never see a lower number.
        run: |
          n=$(( $(date +%s) / 60 ))
          echo "build_number=$n" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Build number $n (minutes since the Unix epoch)." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.44.7'
          cache: true
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 11.10.0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - name: Install Rust iOS target
        run: rustup target add aarch64-apple-ios
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          workspaces: packages/atomic_store_flutter/rust
          key: flutter-ios
          cache-on-failure: true
      - name: Build embedded renderer
        run: bash flutter/scripts/build_embed.sh
      - name: Get Flutter packages
        working-directory: flutter
        run: flutter pub get
      - name: Build iOS release
        if: env.HAS_APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY != 'true'
        working-directory: flutter
        run: flutter build ios --release --no-codesign --build-number=${{ steps.build.outputs.build_number }}
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: env.HAS_APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY != 'true'
        with:
          name: atomic-ios-unsigned
          path: flutter/build/ios/iphoneos/Runner.app
          if-no-files-found: error
      - name: Prepare temporary Apple signing
        env:
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_PRIVATE_KEY }}
        id: signing
        if: env.HAS_APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY == 'true'
        working-directory: flutter
        run: |
          python3 -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/signing-venv"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/signing-venv/bin/pip" install --quiet 'cryptography>=43'
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/signing-venv/bin/python" ios/testflight.py prepare "$RUNNER_TEMP/ios-signing"
          cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/ios-signing
